en: A black and white vintage postcard showing a quiet waterfront street with colonial-style buildings, some with tiled roofs, bordered by a curved wall. There are palm trees and an old street lamp visible, and the street appears to run alongside a body of water. The image has some visible wear and tear, indicating age. The top left corner of the card has printed text: 'S. Thomé. — Rua do Espalmador.'
